newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH POLIFARBS TO OFFER 8.3 MLN SHARES RIGHTS.
newsitem.headline: POLISH POLIFARBS TO OFFER 8.3 MLN SHARES RIGHTS.

text.p: Polish paintmakers Polifarb Cieszyn and Polifarb Wroclaw , which seek a mid-year merger, will conduct a one-for-five rights issue of up to 8,245,764 shares after the merge, Polifarb Cieszyn said.

Polifarb Cieszyn said in a statement on Friday that its shareholders would vote on the issue of at least four million shares at their meeting due on March 24, as well as on a proposal to name the new entity Polifarb Cieszyn-Wroclaw SA.
The statement said the rights issue's record date would come after the registration of the new firm, which was expected by September 30 this year.
Cieszyn shareholders will also vote on a scrip issue of 2,978,820 shares to equal Wroclaw's 22,103,820 shares and set another issue of 22,103,820 shares for Wroclaw shareholders.
Polifarb Cieszyn would take over all the assets of its Wroclaw-based namesake with the new firm based in Wroclaw.
On March 25 Polifarb Wroclaw's shareholders are due to vote on the merger which would create a firm with a market share of more than 40 percent.
